title: Elevator descent at the facility

tellings.quote: In that building we went into an elevator. We took an elevator down, which that was the first odd thing is that it felt like we went down significantly further than like you would think you would.

plain: Randy Anderson, a man who says he was there himself, describes riding an elevator down inside a building at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, sometime in the 1980s. He says it was "the first odd thing": the ride felt like it went down much further than you would expect. If true, it would point to a facility buried deep underground.
